rule.name: NullThrown
rule.boundary: Literal null, including parentheses; casts and computed values are outside the original predicate.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect() { throw (null); } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() { throw new IllegalStateException(); } }

rule.name: InstanceofThis
rule.boundary: Source-visible cases; the original analyzer retains semantic and generated-member analysis.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect() { return this instanceof Runnable; } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(Object value) { return value instanceof Runnable; } }

rule.name: IncrementDecrementUsedAsExpression
rule.boundary: Direct return operands only: excludes void lambdas, field initializers and for initializers where the inspection cannot offer its replacement.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect(int value) { return value++; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(int value) { value++; return value; } }
package example; class Sample { Runnable inspect(int[] values) { return () -> values[0]++; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(int value) { for(int start=value++; start<value; start++) {} return value; } }

rule.name: ConstantDeclaredInAbstractClass
rule.boundary: Public static final fields of explicit abstract classes; interfaces and enums are excluded.

case.source: package example; abstract class Sample { public static final int LIMIT = 1; }
package example; abstract class Sample { private static final int LIMIT = 1; }

rule.name: PublicConstructorInNonPublicClass
rule.boundary: Constructors with parameters only; leaves Externalizable no-argument constructors and implicit public interface members alone.

case.source: package example; class Sample { public Sample(String value) {} }
package example; class Sample { Sample(String value) {} }
package example; interface Sample { class Nested { public Nested(String value) {} } }

rule.name: FieldCount
rule.boundary: Counts explicitly written fields, excluding static-final fields and enum constants. Generated fields remain with Qodana; records already have RecordComponentNumber. UtilityClass and FieldDefaults declarations stay with Qodana because Lombok can change field modifiers.

case.source: package example; class Sample { private int value0; private int value1; private int value2; private int value3; private int value4; private int value5; private int value6; private int value7; }

package example; class Sample { private int value0; private int value1; private int value2; private int value3; private int value4; private int value5; private int value6; private static final int value7 = 1; }
package example; interface Sample { int VALUE0 = 0; int VALUE1 = 1; int VALUE2 = 2; int VALUE3 = 3; int VALUE4 = 4; int VALUE5 = 5; int VALUE6 = 6; int VALUE7 = 7; int VALUE8 = 8; int VALUE9 = 9; }

package example; class Sample { private int value0; private int value1; private int value2; private int value3; private int value4; private int value5; private int value6; class Nested { private int another; } }
package example; class Sample { private int first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth; }
package example; enum Sample { FIRST,SECOND,THIRD,FOURTH,FIFTH,SIXTH,SEVENTH,EIGHTH }

package example; @lombok.experimental.UtilityClass class Sample { private final int value0 = 0; private final int value1 = 1; private final int value2 = 2; private final int value3 = 3; private final int value4 = 4; private final int value5 = 5; private final int value6 = 6; private final int value7 = 7; }

rule.name: ConstructorCount
rule.boundary: Explicit constructors, including deprecated ones; implicit and generated constructors remain with Qodana.

case.source: package example; class Sample { Sample() {} Sample(int value0) {} Sample(int value0, int value1) {} Sample(int value0, int value1, int value2) {} Sample(int value0, int value1, int value2, int value3) {} Sample(int value0, int value1, int value2, int value3, int value4) {} }

package example; class Sample { Sample() {} Sample(int value0) {} Sample(int value0, int value1) {} Sample(int value0, int value1, int value2) {} Sample(int value0, int value1, int value2, int value3) {} }

rule.name: ClassNestingDepth
rule.boundary: Named type declarations; counts anonymous enclosing classes too. Anonymous-class reporting remains with Qodana.

case.source: package example; class Sample { class Second { class Third { class Fourth {} } } }
package example; class Sample { class Second { class Third {} } }

rule.name: NestedConditionalExpression
rule.boundary: Nested conditional expressions outside lambdas and anonymous classes, avoiding callable-boundary differences.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect(boolean first, boolean second) { return first ? 1 : second ? 2 : 3; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(boolean first) { return first ? 1 : 2; } }
package example; class Sample { java.util.function.IntSupplier inspect(boolean first, boolean second) { return first ? () -> second ? 1 : 2 : () -> 3; } }

rule.name: ChainedEquality
rule.boundary: Direct equality chains; the original inspection also decides parenthesized expression structure.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean first, boolean second, boolean third) { return first == second == third; } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean first, boolean second) { return first == second; } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean first,boolean second,boolean third) { return (first == second) == third; } }

rule.name: IfStatementWithTooManyBranches
rule.boundary: The initial branch, each else-if and the final else each count once; threshold is three.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect(int value) { if(value == 0) { return 0; } else if(value == 1) { return 1; } else if(value == 2) { return 2; } else { return 3; } } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(int value) { if(value == 0) { return 0; } else if(value == 1) { return 1; } else { return 2; } } }

rule.name: MethodWithMultipleLoops
rule.boundary: Written methods and constructors; anonymous-class loops are excluded, including when the callable itself is anonymous.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { while(ready) { break; } do { break; } while(ready); } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { while(ready) { break; } } }

rule.name: ThreeNegationsPerMethod
rule.boundary: Counts ! and != including assertions; conservatively leaves every equals-named method and anonymous-class body to Qodana.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean first, boolean second, boolean third, boolean fourth) { return !first && !second && !third && !fourth; } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean first, boolean second, boolean third) { return !first && !second && !third; } }

rule.name: QuestionableName
rule.boundary: Exact case-sensitive profile list on written named declarations; inferred lambda parameters and generated members remain with Qodana.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect(int foo) { return foo; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(int bar) { return bar; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(int Foo, int food, int then) { return Foo + food + then; } }
package example; class Sample { java.util.function.IntUnaryOperator inspect() { return (int foo) -> foo; } }

rule.name: SuppressionNeedsJustification
rule.boundary: Matches the original simple-name and sibling-annotation predicate.

case.source: package example; @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}
package example; @Justification("The caller owns the type") @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}
package example; @java.lang.SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}
package example; @eu.ciechanowiec.airness.Justification("Explicit conversion") @java.lang.SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}

rule.name: JustificationNeedsSuppression
rule.boundary: Matches the original simple-name and sibling-annotation predicate.

case.source: package example; @Justification("The caller owns the type") class Sample {}
package example; @Justification("The caller owns the type") @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}

rule.name: JustificationNeedsText
rule.boundary: Direct empty or whitespace-only string literals. Escaped strings, text blocks and constant expressions remain with PMD.

case.source: package example; @Justification(" ") @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}
package example; @Justification("The caller owns the type") @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") class Sample {}
package example; @Justification("\t") class Sample {}
package example; @Justification(" "+"reason") class Sample {}

rule.name: UninitializedLocalVariable
rule.boundary: Uninitialized local declarations, excluding enhanced-for variables.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect() { int value; value = 1; return value; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect() { int value = 1; return value; } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(String[] values) { for(String value:values) { System.out.println(value); } } }

rule.name: NoThrowsInTestClass
rule.boundary: The original matches class/interface names ending in Test, including declarations nested inside them.

case.source: package example; class SampleTest { void inspect() throws Exception {} }
package example; class SampleTest { void inspect() {} }
package example; class SampleIT { void inspect() throws Exception {} }
package example; class SampleTest { class Nested { Nested() throws Exception {} } }

rule.name: NoAbbreviatedNames
rule.boundary: Copies the PMD abbreviation expression and Override exemption. Inferred lambda parameters remain with PMD.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect(int cfg) { return cfg; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect(int configuration) { return configuration; } }
package example; class Sample { @Override public String toString() { return "stated"; } }
package example; class Sample { @Override public String getCfg() { return "stated"; } }

rule.name: NativeQueryNeedsJustification
rule.boundary: Same method, simple annotation name, member name and boolean literal as the PMD predicate.

case.source: package example; interface Sample { @Query(value="select 1", nativeQuery=true) long inspect(); }
package example; interface Sample { @Query(value="select 1", nativeQuery=false) long inspect(); }
package example; interface Sample { @org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query(value="select 1", nativeQuery=true) long inspect(); }

rule.name: NullablePersistentValueNeedsJustification
rule.boundary: Same annotated enclosing class/record and field/component scope; constructors are not inspected.

case.source: package example; @Entity class Sample { @Nullable private String value; }
package example; class Sample { @Nullable private String value; }
package example; @jakarta.persistence.Entity class Sample { private java.util.List<@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable String> value; }
package example; @Entity record Sample(@Nullable String value) {}
package example; @Entity class Sample { Sample(@Nullable String value) {} }

rule.name: PairedConditionParentheses
rule.boundary: Custom token-position check preserves the PMD statement/condition/body line predicate.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { while(ready) { break; } } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { if(ready) { System.nanoTime(); } } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { do { System.nanoTime(); } while(ready); } }

rule.name: AvoidSynchronizedAtMethodLevel
rule.boundary: Explicit synchronized method modifier.

case.source: package example; class Sample { synchronized void inspect() {} }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() {} }

rule.name: AvoidSynchronizedStatement
rule.boundary: Every synchronized statement.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect(Object lock) { synchronized(lock) { System.nanoTime(); } } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(Object lock) { System.nanoTime(); } }

rule.name: AvoidUsingVolatile
rule.boundary: Explicit volatile fields.

case.source: package example; class Sample { private volatile int value; }
package example; class Sample { private final int value = 1; }

rule.name: ForLoopVariableCount
rule.boundary: The default maximumVariables is one; counts declarations in a traditional for initializer.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect() { for(int first=0, second=0; first<1; first++) {} } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() { for(int first=0; first<1; first++) {} } }

rule.name: DoNotThrowExceptionInFinally
rule.boundary: Preserves the original descendant predicate, which includes nested declarations.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect() { try { System.nanoTime(); } finally { throw new IllegalStateException(); } } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() { try { throw new IllegalStateException(); } finally { System.nanoTime(); } } }

rule.name: ReturnFromFinallyBlock
rule.boundary: Returns within finally, excluding nested methods and lambdas; conservatively excludes enclosing lambdas too.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect() { try { return 1; } finally { return 2; } } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect() { try { return 1; } finally { Runnable action = () -> { return; }; action.run(); } } }

rule.name: ForLoopShouldBeWhileLoop
rule.boundary: Traditional for statements with a condition and empty initializer/update.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { for(;ready;) { break; } } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() { for(int value=0;value<1;value++) {} } }

rule.name: MethodWithSameNameAsEnclosingClass
rule.boundary: Matches the original class/interface ancestor-name predicate; constructors are excluded.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void Sample() {} }
package example; class Sample { Sample() {} }
package example; class Sample { class Nested { void Sample() {} } }
package example; class Sample { void sample() {} }
package example; record Sample(int value) { void Sample() {} }

rule.name: AvoidFieldNameMatchingTypeName
rule.boundary: Case-insensitive field-name comparison against the nearest class/interface declaration.

case.source: package example; class Sample { private int sample; }
package example; class Sample { private int value; }
package example; class Sample { private int SAMPLE; }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() { int sample=1; System.out.println(sample); } }
package example; class Sample { class Nested { private int sample; } }

rule.name: LongVariable
rule.boundary: Written variable declarations; inferred lambda parameters remain with PMD.

case.source: package example; class Sample { private int aVariableNameThatIsLongerThanThirtyCharacters; }
package example; class Sample { private int meaningfulName; }

rule.name: ShortClassName
rule.boundary: The configured minimum is three; PMD ClassDeclaration excludes records, enums and annotation types.

case.source: package example; class Ab {}
package example; class Sample {}

rule.name: ShortMethodName
rule.boundary: The configured minimum is two; constructors are excluded.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void a() {} }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() {} }

rule.name: SimplifiedTernary
rule.boundary: Direct boolean-literal children of a conditional expression, except expressions containing a direct null literal.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean ready) { return ready ? true : false; } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean ready) { return ready; } }

rule.name: LogicInversion
rule.boundary: Equality and inequality only; relational comparisons can involve floating-point NaN semantics.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(int first,int second) { return !(first == second); } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(int first,int second) { return first != second; } }

rule.name: UnconditionalIfStatement
rule.boundary: Literal boolean conditions only; inferred local values remain with PMD.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect() { if(true) { System.nanoTime(); } } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { if(ready) { System.nanoTime(); } } }

rule.name: AvoidMultipleUnaryOperators
rule.boundary: Reports the outermost unary expression containing another unary expression.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean ready) { return !!ready; } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(boolean ready) { return !ready; } }

rule.name: EqualsNull
rule.boundary: Like the original predicate, this matches method name and literal argument, without resolving the method.

case.source: package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(Object value) { return value.equals(null); } }
package example; class Sample { boolean inspect(Object value,Object other) { return value.equals(other); } }

rule.name: UseNotifyAllInsteadOfNotify
rule.boundary: Like PMD, matches the zero-argument method name without type resolution.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect() { notify(); } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect() { notifyAll(); } }

rule.name: AvoidThreadGroup
rule.boundary: The name-only method-call branch of the original XPath; constructor type resolution remains with PMD.

case.source: package example; class Sample { Object inspect(Thread thread) { return thread.getThreadGroup(); } }
package example; class Sample { Object inspect(Thread thread) { return thread; } }

rule.name: InstantiationToGetClass
rule.boundary: Direct constructor-call receiver, matching the original name-only predicate.

case.source: package example; class Sample { Class<?> inspect() { return new Object().getClass(); } }
package example; class Sample { Class<?> inspect() { return Object.class; } }

rule.name: UseShortArrayInitializer
rule.boundary: Explicit array types on ordinary declarations; inferred variables and creation without an initializer are excluded.

case.source: package example; class Sample { private int[] values = new int[] {1}; }
package example; class Sample { private int[] values = {1}; }

rule.name: ProtectedMemberInFinalClass
rule.boundary: Written protected non-method members and methods without an explicit superclass; skips possible Object overrides.

case.source: package example; final class Sample { protected int value; }
package example; final class Sample { private int value; }
package example; final class Sample { protected void inspect() {} }
package example; final class Sample extends Base { @Override protected void inspect() {} } class Base { protected void inspect() {} }

rule.name: AnonymousClassMethodCount
rule.boundary: Explicit methods of anonymous classes; generated members and enum-constant bodies remain with Qodana.

case.source: package example; class Sample { Object inspect() { return new Object() { void method0() {} void method1() {} void method2() {} void method3() {} void method4() {} void method5() {} void method6() {} void method7() {} void method8() {} void method9() {} void method10() {} void method11() {} void method12() {} void method13() {} void method14() {} void method15() {} }; } }
package example; class Sample { Object inspect() { return new Object() { void inspect() {} }; } }

rule.name: AvoidUsingOctalValues
rule.boundary: Underscore-free octal values above seven, preserving PMD strict=false; other literal spellings remain with PMD.

case.source: package example; class Sample { int inspect() { return 010; } }
package example; class Sample { int inspect() { return 007; } }
package example; class Sample { long inspect() { return 010L; } }

rule.name: NullAssignment
rule.boundary: Array-element assignments only. Named-reference assignments require the original symbol analysis to preserve its final-variable exemption.

case.source: package example; class Sample { void inspect(Object[] values) { values[0] = null; } }
package example; class Sample { void inspect(Object[] values,Object replacement) { values[0] = replacement; } }

rule.name: CollapsibleIfStatements
rule.boundary: Braced nested if statements with no else or other body statement. Comments do not count as statements.

package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean first,boolean second) { if(first && second) { System.nanoTime(); } } }

rule.name: UnnecessaryReturn
rule.boundary: Direct trailing return in a void method only; nested control flow and lambdas remain with PMD.

package example; class Sample { void inspect(boolean ready) { if(ready) { return; } System.nanoTime(); } }

rule.boundary: Written ordinary declarations; preserves loop/catch/lambda and unnamed-variable exceptions.
